'''Gut-Guro''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the band of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bandin Dobah]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After being informed by [[Zalg]] that a group of adventurers tracked down Dobah to retrieve the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R4-W9]], he tried with [[Daro Blunt]] and [[Spir Fraxis]] to kill them.
